A reader takes the composite invariance to be available here.

findings.evidence: PhaseSpace.lean:325-329 applies `mul_nonneg (γ_pos hβ).le (sub_nonneg.2 ?_)` and then discharges the second factor via `PiLp.norm_apply_le` and `norm_le_onShellEnergy`.
findings.fix: Reword to "positivity of γ is one of the two ingredients in the non-negativity of the boosted energy `γ (E - β pᵢ)`, the other being `|β pᵢ| ≤ E`", or drop the causal claim.
findings.issue: "That is what makes a boost preserve the sign of the energy of an on-shell momentum" is inaccurate: γ > 0 is only one ingredient. The actual proof (`massShell_massShellAction_boost`, PhaseSpace.lean:320-329) needs both `0 < γ β` and `β * p i ≤ onShellEnergy m p`, i.e. `norm_le_onShellEnergy`.

summary: Module docstrings and all public definitions/main theorems are present and largely accurate, but the PhaseSpace module docstring closes by asserting an invariance result (finite products of boosts and rotations preserve the measure) that no declaration in the file states, and the γ_pos module docstring attributes energy-sign preservation to γ > 0 alone.
